Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp I level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "⚡ Fonti energetiche non rinnovabili", solid fill #E65100, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:

  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Calcola l'impronta di carbonio della tua famiglia per…" | "somma le emissioni da riscaldamento, trasporti e bolletta…" | "Professione futura: Energy Manager Aziendale"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "combustibili fossili" | "energia non rinnovabile" | "impatto ambientale" | "nucleare" | "combustibile fossile"
